description: This file is a shell script that implements a Git update hook for repository access control, including rules for branches and tags, and user/group permissions.

methods.name: grant
methods.description: Outputs 'grant' and exits with status 0 to allow access.

methods.name: deny
methods.description: Outputs 'deny' and exits with status 1 to deny access.

methods.name: info
methods.description: Outputs informational messages when verbose mode is enabled.
